mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over three consecutive months signals an easing monetary policy cycle, reducing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS falls by > 0.25% per month for 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during easing episodes (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 6% for two consecutive months signals weakening labor market conditions, lowering corporate earnings expectations and reducing equity valuations, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of high unemployment (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals weakening aggregate demand, reducing corporate revenue expectations and depressing equity valuations, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of falling consumption (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below its 12-month moving average for three consecutive months signals weakening manufacturing activity, reducing earnings expectations and depressing equity valuations, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of falling industrial production (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) above its 12-month moving average for three consecutive months signals strengthening labor market conditions, raising earnings expectations and boosting equity valuations, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of rising employment (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% for three consecutive months signals a tightening monetary policy cycle, raising discount rates and reducing equity valuations, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of rising rates (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) above its 12-month moving average for two consecutive quarters signals strengthening aggregate demand, raising corporate revenue expectations and boosting equity valuations, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of rising consumption (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 6% for two consecutive months combined with a decline in payroll employment (PAYEMS) below its 12-month moving average for two consecutive months signals a deteriorating labor market, lowering earnings expectations and reducing equity valuations, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 6% for 2 months AND PAYEMS < 12-month MA for 2 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of rising unemployment and falling payroll employment (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.
